lines.text: Many learners say: She can speaks English.
After can, use the short verb.

data.why: After can, use the short verb.

native.tip: 中文的动词从不加 s，但英语 she 后面的动词常要加 s。可是 can 后面一律用原形。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “She can speaks English.”😅 can 后面的动词不加 s，要用原形 speak：“She can speak English.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“She can speak English.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: After can, the verb never gets an s.
en.caption: Do you say “She can speaks English.” 😅 After can, the verb never gets an s: “She can speak English.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
